entry.name: Create payment
entry.description: Amount is an integer in minor currency units. New payments start in pending state.
entry.plain_explanation: Amount is an integer in minor currency units. New payments start in pending state.

facts: Amount is an integer in minor currency units. New payments start in pending state.

entry.name: Confirm payment
entry.description: Confirmation authorizes a pending payment and moves it to authorized state; it does not capture funds.
entry.plain_explanation: Confirmation authorizes a pending payment and moves it to authorized state; it does not capture funds.

facts: Confirmation authorizes a pending payment and moves it to authorized state; it does not capture funds.

entry.name: Capture payment
entry.description: Capture collects funds from an authorized payment. Capturing a pending payment returns 409.
entry.plain_explanation: Capture collects funds from an authorized payment. Capturing a pending payment returns 409.

facts: Capture collects funds from an authorized payment. Capturing a pending payment returns 409.

entry.name: Refund payment
entry.description: Only captured payments can be refunded. Refund amount cannot exceed the captured amount.
entry.plain_explanation: Only captured payments can be refunded. Refund amount cannot exceed the captured amount.

facts: Only captured payments can be refunded. Refund amount cannot exceed the captured amount.

entry.name: Get payment
entry.description: Returns payment id, amount, currency and current state. This read does not modify the payment.
entry.plain_explanation: Returns payment id, amount, currency and current state. This read does not modify the payment.

facts: Returns payment id, amount, currency and current state. This read does not modify the payment.

entry.name: Create message template
entry.description: Creates a reusable text template and returns template_id. Template creation does not send messages.
entry.plain_explanation: Creates a reusable text template and returns template_id. Template creation does not send messages.

facts: Creates a reusable text template and returns template_id. Template creation does not send messages.

entry.name: Send template message
entry.description: Sends an existing template to one recipient and returns message_id. An unknown template_id returns 404.
entry.plain_explanation: Sends an existing template to one recipient and returns message_id. An unknown template_id returns 404.

facts: Sends an existing template to one recipient and returns message_id. An unknown template_id returns 404.

entry.name: Get message delivery
entry.description: Returns queued, delivered or failed delivery state for a message_id. It does not resend a message.
entry.plain_explanation: Returns queued, delivered or failed delivery state for a message_id. It does not resend a message.

facts: Returns queued, delivered or failed delivery state for a message_id. It does not resend a message.

entry.name: Send plain email
entry.description: Sends plain text email without a template. Returns email_id, not message_id.
entry.plain_explanation: Sends plain text email without a template. Returns email_id, not message_id.

facts: Sends plain text email without a template. Returns email_id, not message_id.

entry.name: Issue access token
entry.description: grant_type must be client_credentials. Returns access_token and expires_in of 3600 seconds.
entry.plain_explanation: grant_type must be client_credentials. Returns access_token and expires_in of 3600 seconds.

facts: grant_type must be client_credentials. Returns access_token and expires_in of 3600 seconds.

entry.name: Read user profile
entry.description: Returns user_id and display_name. Expired tokens return 401. Email addresses are not returned.
entry.plain_explanation: Returns user_id and display_name. Expired tokens return 401. Email addresses are not returned.

facts: Returns user_id and display_name. Expired tokens return 401. Email addresses are not returned.

entry.name: Revoke access token
entry.description: Revokes the supplied access token immediately. This operation does not delete the user profile.
entry.plain_explanation: Revokes the supplied access token immediately. This operation does not delete the user profile.

facts: Revokes the supplied access token immediately. This operation does not delete the user profile.

entry.name: Create cart
entry.description: Creates a cart from product ids and quantities. Returns cart_id. It does not reserve inventory.
entry.plain_explanation: Creates a cart from product ids and quantities. Returns cart_id. It does not reserve inventory.

facts: Creates a cart from product ids and quantities. Returns cart_id. It does not reserve inventory.

entry.name: Create order
entry.description: Converts an existing cart into an unpaid order and returns order_id. A missing cart returns 404.
entry.plain_explanation: Converts an existing cart into an unpaid order and returns order_id. A missing cart returns 404.

facts: Converts an existing cart into an unpaid order and returns order_id. A missing cart returns 404.

entry.name: Create shipment
entry.description: Creates a shipment for an existing order and returns tracking_id. Missing address returns 400.
entry.plain_explanation: Creates a shipment for an existing order and returns tracking_id. Missing address returns 400.

facts: Creates a shipment for an existing order and returns tracking_id. Missing address returns 400.

entry.name: Read inventory
entry.description: Returns available quantity for a product sku. Reading inventory does not reserve any units.
entry.plain_explanation: Returns available quantity for a product sku. Reading inventory does not reserve any units.

facts: Returns available quantity for a product sku. Reading inventory does not reserve any units.

entry.name: Cancel order
entry.description: Cancels an unshipped order. An order with a shipment returns 409. It does not automatically refund payments.
entry.plain_explanation: Cancels an unshipped order. An order with a shipment returns 409. It does not automatically refund payments.

facts: Cancels an unshipped order. An order with a shipment returns 409. It does not automatically refund payments.

entry.name: Submit analytics event
entry.description: Repeated event_id values are deduplicated for 24 hours. New events appear in reports after 15 minutes.
entry.plain_explanation: Repeated event_id values are deduplicated for 24 hours. New events appear in reports after 15 minutes.

facts: Repeated event_id values are deduplicated for 24 hours. New events appear in reports after 15 minutes.

entry.name: Read daily report
entry.description: Returns daily event counts in UTC. Newly submitted events have a 15 minute reporting delay.
entry.plain_explanation: Returns daily event counts in UTC. Newly submitted events have a 15 minute reporting delay.

facts: Returns daily event counts in UTC. Newly submitted events have a 15 minute reporting delay.

entry.name: Start report export
entry.description: Starts an asynchronous CSV export and returns job_id. Export initiation does not return CSV bytes.
entry.plain_explanation: Starts an asynchronous CSV export and returns job_id. Export initiation does not return CSV bytes.

facts: Starts an asynchronous CSV export and returns job_id. Export initiation does not return CSV bytes.

entry.name: Read export job
entry.description: Returns pending, ready or failed job state. download_url is present only when state is ready.
entry.plain_explanation: Returns pending, ready or failed job state. download_url is present only when state is ready.

facts: Returns pending, ready or failed job state. download_url is present only when state is ready.

entry.name: Upload file
entry.description: Uploads at most 10 MiB and returns file_id. Larger content returns 413. Upload does not create a sharing link.
entry.plain_explanation: Uploads at most 10 MiB and returns file_id. Larger content returns 413. Upload does not create a sharing link.

facts: Uploads at most 10 MiB and returns file_id. Larger content returns 413. Upload does not create a sharing link.

entry.name: Create sharing link
entry.description: Creates a sharing URL for an existing file. expires_in is required and cannot exceed 3600 seconds.
entry.plain_explanation: Creates a sharing URL for an existing file. expires_in is required and cannot exceed 3600 seconds.

facts: Creates a sharing URL for an existing file. expires_in is required and cannot exceed 3600 seconds.

entry.name: Delete file
entry.description: Deletes the file and invalidates all its sharing links. Deleting an unknown file returns 404.
entry.plain_explanation: Deletes the file and invalidates all its sharing links. Deleting an unknown file returns 404.

facts: Deletes the file and invalidates all its sharing links. Deleting an unknown file returns 404.

entry.name: Read file metadata
entry.description: Returns filename and size_bytes for an existing file. It does not return the uploaded content.
entry.plain_explanation: Returns filename and size_bytes for an existing file. It does not return the uploaded content.

facts: Returns filename and size_bytes for an existing file. It does not return the uploaded content.
